note: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Every `voice` below is a stub until Matt auditions Adobe Firefly's voices and dictates the real names; the game never reads this file, so a wrong value here costs a re-record and nothing else. `settings` is Firefly's own UI — whatever the web page calls the knobs — copied here so a batch is reproducible months later. A batch's sidecar records the profile it was cut under, so changing a value here does not silently reinterpret clips already recorded.

seraphina.note: The four-year-old. Most of the book. edge-tts stands in with en-US-AnaNeural at -8%.

dad.note: Grown man, warm and slow. edge-tts stands in with en-US-GuyNeural at -10%, -15Hz.

morgana.note: The friend. Brighter and quicker than Seraphina. edge-tts stands in at +6%, +40Hz.

sneak.note: The faerie boy. Lower than the girls. edge-tts stands in at +4%, -35Hz.

storybook.note: The book pages, read to somebody rather than said to them. Same person as `seraphina`; the slow delivery lives in Firefly's UI settings, not in our data — which is exactly why this is a separate profile and not a `rate` on a line. edge-tts stands in with the -22% on the four book_pip_moon_* lines.

overrides.why: Book pages. Spoken by Seraphina, but at storybook pace — see the storybook profile.
